summary: ACCEPT. Combined acceptance: BMad AC-1 through AC-6, SpecKit FR-001 through FR-019 and SC-001 through SC-007, and remediation tasks T001 through T018 are satisfied by the unchanged accepted Story 4.3 behavior plus the candidate closure evidence. The three reserved HIGH/MUST/Strong defects are closed: framework detection consumes and verifies the archive-only lease, every public coordinator constructor requires the snapshot and real Pre-Scan detector seams with no empty/missing adapters, and only RepositoryProfileCommitDraft can make the final profile plus Pre-Scan Result durable. The production-composition-discovered ancestor-Git defect is also closed: ScanCandidateEnumerator performs no Git invocation, deterministically inventories the materialized archive, skips reparse directories, classifies reparse files without reading them, and in production is bounded by the already verified committed snapshot's 10,000-entry and 64 MiB limits before the lease is reverified prior to atomic persistence. Architecture passes Core/Infrastructure boundaries, required production seams, atomicity/idempotency, and no PRD/tool/dispatch/provider-failover expansion. Migration neutrality passes because the candidate changes no EF model, configuration, DbContext, or migration path; root evidence reports the clean model gate and 3/3 migration checks. Remaining nonblocking risks are QR5-001, the explicitly deferred detector/catalog test-locality debt, and the previously accepted case-distinct Linux path and general nested-YAML limitations; none is introduced as a product-completion claim.
